text: Found the cause: a flag option (is_flag=True) that is required=True gets a default of False, so it is never reported as missing. Fixing Option.__init__ in src/click/core.py. ETA ~5 min.
Investigating: echo() failing when there are no streams (sys.stdout is None). ETA ~12 min.
Bug #2 fixed: echo/pager/progressbar no longer crash when sys.stdout/sys.stderr are None (edits in _compat.py, utils.py, _termui_impl.py). Full suite still green (488 passed).
Investigating: envvar/flag_value behaviour in core.py. ETA ~8 min.
Found it: in decorators.py, `argument` pops `cls` from the shared attrs dict inside the decorator, so reusing the same decorator loses the custom class. Fixing now. ETA ~6 min.
Investigating: click.Path symlink resolution in types.py. ETA ~10 min.

Fixed and verified: `Option.__init__` no longer forces `default=False` for a required flag, so `--flag` with `is_flag=True, required=True` now errors with "Missing option '--flag'" (exit 2) when omitted. Full suite green (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).

Fixed and verified: `_compat._make_cached_stream_func` returns None when the source stream is None, `echo` returns early when there is no stream, and `ProgressBar`/`pager` fall back to StringIO. `click.echo("test")` with `sys.stdout = sys.stderr = None` no longer raises. Full suite green.

Fixed and verified: `decorators.argument` now copies `attrs` before popping `cls`, so a pre-defined `click.argument(..., cls=CustomArgument)` decorator keeps the custom class on every use. Full suite green.

Fixed and verified: `Path.convert` no longer replaces the path with the raw `os.readlink` target (which broke relative symlinks); it now uses `os.path.realpath`, so `resolve_path=True` returns the fully resolved path. Full suite green.
Still investigating the flag + default_map path in core.py; nothing conclusive yet. ETA ~6 min.
Still investigating the envvar/flag_value path in core.py; nothing conclusive yet. ETA ~6 min.

Status: 4 of the 6 reported bugs are fixed and verified with the full suite green (required flag options, echo with no streams, reused argument decorator cls, Path symlink resolution). The envvar/flag_value bug in core.py is still being traced — I have not found a divergence from the documented contract yet, so no change has been made there.

Status: the flag + default_map path in core.py is still under investigation; no change made yet (the flag/default_map precedence in Parameter.consume_value and Option.get_default currently behaves as documented, so I have not found the divergence yet).
